**Finding: compliant (preferred position met) — no redline proposed.**

Rule LD looks for liquidated damages, penalties or minimum/exit fees payable by us. I inspected every location where such an amount could sit:

- **§ 13 Term / § 14 Termination (p0078, p0079):** either party may decline renewal on 30 days' notice, and on our election to terminate TrueLink simply continues services "until the last day of the month following the month" of notice. There is no early-termination fee, exit charge, accelerated payment or minimum-fee-on-termination.
- **§ 5 Compensation / § 6 Documentation and Disputes (p0045, p0047):** only fees for services actually requested, plus a monthly fee floor for services delivered during the term, and a contested-amounts mechanic. No late-payment penalty or default interest.
- **§ 7 Unsolicited Commercial E-Mail (p0049) and § 8(f) (p0058)** — the planner's most likely source — give TrueLink only technical prevention measures and general "legal and equitable rights," not a per-message or fixed penalty.
- **§ 8 Client covenants (p0051–p0056):** no stipulated damages for breach.
- **§ 12 indemnity (p0071–p0072) and § 21 cumulative rights (p0087):** actual-loss and at-law remedies, not pre-agreed sums; the only liability cap (p0077) runs in our favour against TrueLink.

Since we pay no liquidated damages or penalties anywhere, the clause sits at the **preferred** position, not merely the fallback, and nothing should be redlined. If TrueLink later seeks an exit charge in negotiation, our fallback is a single early-termination fee capped at three months' fees as the sole liquidated amount.
